description: This file defines core functions, structures, macros, and constants for the ATM driver in the Lantiq MIPS platform, including configuration options, debug settings, and data structures for ATM connections and descriptors.

classes.name: ltq_atm_ops
classes.description: Structure containing function pointers for ATM core operations such as init, shutdown, start, stop, and firmware version retrieval.

classes.name: port
classes.description: Represents an ATM port with maximum and current cell rates and a device pointer.

classes.name: connection
classes.description: Represents an ATM connection with VCC, descriptors, buffers, and statistics.

classes.name: atm_priv_data
classes.description: Main data structure holding ATM connection table, descriptors, buffers, port info, and statistics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Function pointer for initializing the ATM core with a platform device.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Function pointer for shutting down the ATM core.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Function pointer to start ATM processing on a given port or process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Function pointer to stop ATM processing.

methods.name: fw_ver
methods.description: Function pointer to retrieve firmware version (major and minor).
